findings.text: non-blocking: the check fires on any prose mention of "write path(s)" rather than only on a label sentence, so over this repository's own docs it reports 549 sections (297 in docs/plans, 238 in docs/evidence), 137 of which already carry a parseable "Write paths:" label in the same section; the message then asserts a sentence is unparseable when the readers do parse the section's label. raw_text:
VERDICT goal: the node goal is that a section's write-paths label is read whether it ends in a colon or a full stop; reckon/crew/plan_review.py:5464 now compiles r"write\s+paths?\s*[.:]", and reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:338 imports that same pattern, so both readers take either form.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when names four cases in tests/test_a_write_paths_sentence_is_read_in_either_form.py; the file holds seven tests covering exactly those four, and the manifest records the head arm at 58 passed, EXIT=0.
VERDICT write_paths: the declared scope is reckon/crew/plan_review.py, reckon/doccheck.py, tests/test_a_write_paths_sentence_is_read_in_either_form.py, the landing fragment and the figure directory; the diff touches the first four and writes no figure.
VERDICT manifest: read; it states the head arm 58 passed and the base arm 51 passed, names every log, and its landing line quotes the negative control at 4 failed, 3 passed, EXIT=1.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit against 465c2df0; c3ca399f changes two product files and adds the test, c44de374 adds the landing fragment, 310 insertions and 2 deletions across four files all inside the declared scope.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew/plan_review.py:code_review_paths_from_plan, reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:_PlanRead.write_paths, reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:_PlanRead.done_when, reckon/doccheck.py:audit_html
SCORE goal_fidelity: 19
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/plan_review.py:5464 widens the one shared pattern and reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:338 imports it, so neither reader can drift from the other.
SCORE evidence: 18
JUSTIFICATION evidence: base-arm.log and head-arm.log each end in a bare EXIT=0 line at their own revision, and negative-control.log ends EXIT=1 with the four full-stop cases failing.
SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: every path in the diff is one of the declared write paths in the source run's manifest, and the declared figure directory was left unused.
SCORE durability: 19
JUSTIFICATION durability: reinstating the colon-only pattern reddens four assertions at negative-control.log, including the batch-queue case that reads runs.read_pointer rather than a value the test passed in.
SCORE fit: 18
JUSTIFICATION fit: reckon/doccheck.py:1062 imports a private name from reckon.crew lazily, matching the existing lazy crew imports at reckon/doccheck.py:2215 and 2242.
SCORE reuse: 20
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the audit check imports the same _WRITE_PATHS_SENTENCE the two readers use rather than compiling a second copy, so there is one owner of the sentence's grammar.
FINDING reckon/doccheck.py:1068 non-blocking: the new audit check fires on any prose mention of "write path(s)", not only on a label sentence, so running it over this repository's own docs reports 549 sections (297 in docs/plans, 238 in docs/evidence), 137 of which already carry a parseable "Write paths:" label in the same section — the finding then tells a reader a sentence is unparseable when it is not.
